goal: Allow txindex to run alongside block pruning on storage-constrained nodes
Return missing block hashes on lookups so callers can fetch pruned blocks on demand
Support partial indexing starting from the oldest retained block on pruned nodes
agreement: Concept approved for enabling txindex lookups on pruned nodes (l0rinc, ajtowns, arejula27)
Unaddressed objection: changing getindexinfo synced semantics may break clients (fjahr)
Suggests splitting basic prune support from partial indexing (fjahr)
Requests interface tweaks, std::variant for lookups, and broader test coverage (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes the mutual exclusion between txindex and block pruning
Pruned node operators can index and look up transactions without keeping full raw block files

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it surfaces missing pruned block hashes in structured error payloads
Callers can use the returned block hashes to fetch missing blocks via getblockfrompeer
